item.text:
The new empty-state registration flow does not refresh the digestion card after a successful save, leaving the newly added resource invisible until reload.

Review comment:

- [P2] Refresh the digestion card after registration — /private/var/folders/c1/l4z5k02n2779byvnymzxsvth0000gn/T/review-bench.9ca6Cd/repo/app/roadmap/RoadmapClient.tsx:618-618
  When the empty-state CTA is used, this callback only opens the already-mounted registration modal. A successful save runs `onResourceAdded`, which invalidates the cache and increments `resourceVersion` only for `SubjectProgressBoard`; `WeeklyDigestionCard` receives no refresh signal and retains `resources = []`, so it continues claiming that no resources exist until a full reload. Pass it a version/reload signal or update its state after saving.
